notes.title: She Wants me Dead - Achievements Edition
notes.notes:
Hello There cat friends. In order to celebrate the release on both Nintendo Switch and Xbox, we have updated the game with achievements for you to enjoy. Have a great weekend and remember to always be nice to your cat... just to be safe 🐱

Keep calm and keep streaming :)
